title: UI/UX Design Intern (Summer 2027)
note: UX for interactive installations in museums, venues and branded spaces; open to UI/UX, interaction, graphic and industrial design students; portfolio required.

facts.summary: Full-time hourly summer internship in DI's Creative Studio, designing digital experiences that live inside physical environments.
facts.duties: User flows, journey maps, wireframes and Figma prototypes; detailed UI design; research and concept sketching; presentations; working with creative technology, software and engineering teams.
facts.requirements: Student in UI/UX, interaction, graphic or industrial design or related; Figma; Adobe Illustrator, InDesign, Photoshop; visual storytelling; motion/3D/After Effects/SketchUp a plus.
facts.apply: Apply on DI's Paycom portal with a portfolio; deadline Dec 31, earlier is better. Posted 2026-09-24.
